reason: The requirements settle the core field shape (a first-class, optional, 250-character, translatable, product-level field) and the end-to-end delivery with tests. Several things are only partly covered: they show the field on the product page but never say to keep it out of cart, checkout and emails; they include a migration but never say there is no backfill; and they expose the field in GraphQL but leave out webhooks, CSV export and the no filter or search rule. Permissions (MANAGE_PRODUCTS to edit, public read) are not mentioned, and no contradictions were planted or found in the requirements.
